fields.source:
-- ophyd-electrochemistry M4 finite-hold proof plus narrow M5 buffer proof.
--
-- This is intentionally not the operational acquisition runtime. It supports
-- only a bounded current hold and an explicitly bounded buffer proof on an
-- explicitly configured resistive commissioning load.
-- External ABORT, measurement cutoffs, and arbitrary waveforms remain disabled.
-- The host accepts only this packaged source and verifies the ABI.
oe_m4_runtime_abi = "oe-k2460-m4-hold-v1"
oe_m4_runtime_build = "m4-finite-current-hold-v14"
oe_m4_state = "idle"
oe_m4_mode = "none"
oe_m4_ready_line = 1
oe_m4_busy_line = 2
oe_m4_start_line = 3
oe_m4_ready_asserted = 1
oe_m4_busy_asserted = 1
oe_m4_ready_level = -1
oe_m4_busy_level = -1
oe_m4_start_level = -1
oe_m4_complete_block = 0
oe_m4_timeout_block = 0
oe_m5_buffer = nil
oe_m5_buffer_capacity = 0
oe_m5_measurement_count = 0
oe_m5_measurement_profile_code = 0
local function oe_m4_require_number(value, name)
    if type(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value then
        error(name .. " must be a real number")
    end
end
local function oe_m4_require_line(value, name)
    oe_m4_require_number(value, name)
    if value < 1 or value > 6 or value ~= math.floor(value) then
        error(name .. " must be an integer in 1..6")
    end
end
local function oe_m4_bit(line)
    return 2 ^ (line - 1)
end
local function oe_m4_digio_event(line)
    if line == 1 then return trigger.EVENT_DIGIO1 end
    if line == 2 then return trigger.EVENT_DIGIO2 end
    if line == 3 then return trigger.EVENT_DIGIO3 end
    if line == 4 then return trigger.EVENT_DIGIO4 end
    if line == 5 then return trigger.EVENT_DIGIO5 end
    if line == 6 then return trigger.EVENT_DIGIO6 end
    error("digital trigger line must be in 1..6")
end
local function oe_m4_level(asserted, asserted_level)
    if asserted then
        return asserted_level
    end
    return 1 - asserted_level
end
local function oe_m4_pattern(ready, busy)
    local pattern = 0
    if oe_m4_level(ready, oe_m4_ready_asserted) == 1 then
        pattern = pattern + oe_m4_bit(oe_m4_ready_line)
    end
    if oe_m4_level(busy, oe_m4_busy_asserted) == 1 then
        pattern = pattern + oe_m4_bit(oe_m4_busy_line)
    end
    return pattern
end
local function oe_m4_mask()
    return oe_m4_bit(oe_m4_ready_line) + oe_m4_bit(oe_m4_busy_line)
end
local function oe_m4_track_flags(ready, busy)
    oe_m4_ready_level = oe_m4_level(ready, oe_m4_ready_asserted)
    oe_m4_busy_level = oe_m4_level(busy, oe_m4_busy_asserted)
end
local function oe_m4_set_flags(ready, busy)
    oe_m4_track_flags(ready, busy)
    digio.line[oe_m4_ready_line].state = oe_m4_ready_level
    digio.line[oe_m4_busy_line].state = oe_m4_busy_level
end
local function oe_m4_model_active()
    local model_state = trigger.model.state()
    return model_state == trigger.STATE_RUNNING or
        model_state == trigger.STATE_WAITING or
        model_state == trigger.STATE_ABORTING
end
function oe_m4_initialize()
    smu.source.output = smu.OFF
    oe_m4_state = "idle"
    oe_m4_mode = "none"
    oe_m4_start_level = -1
    oe_m5_measurement_count = 0
    oe_m5_measurement_profile_code = 0
end
local function oe_m5_nplc_for_profile(profile_code)
    oe_m4_require_number(profile_code, "measurement_profile")
    if profile_code ~= math.floor(profile_code) then
        error("M5 measurement profile code must be an integer")
    end
    if profile_code == 1 then return 1 end
    if profile_code == 2 then return 0.1 end
    if profile_code == 3 then return 0.01 end
    error("M5 measurement profile code is not allowlisted")
end
function oe_m5_prepare_profiled_current_hold_acquisition(
    current_a,
    source_range_a,
    voltage_limit_v,
    measurement_count,
    external_start,
    start_timeout_s,
    event_poll_s,
    front_terminals,
    remote_sense,
    ready_line,
    busy_line,
    start_line,
    ready_asserted,
    busy_asserted,
    start_edge_mode,
    measurement_profile)
    oe_m4_require_number(measurement_count, "measurement_count")
    if measurement_count < 1 or measurement_count > 5000000 or
        measurement_count ~= math.floor(measurement_count) then
        error("M5 proof measurement count must be an integer in 1..5000000")
    end
    if oe_m5_buffer ~= nil and oe_m5_buffer.n > 0 then
        error("retained M5 proof data must be explicitly discarded before prepare")
    end
    if voltage_limit_v > 0.2 then
        error("M5 voltage limit exceeds the fixed 0.2 V measurement range")
    end
    local measurement_nplc = oe_m5_nplc_for_profile(measurement_profile)
    oe_m4_prepare_current_hold(
        current_a,
        source_range_a,
        voltage_limit_v,
        0.001,
        external_start,
        start_timeout_s,
        event_poll_s,
        front_terminals,
        remote_sense,
        ready_line,
        busy_line,
        start_line,
        ready_asserted,
        busy_asserted,
        start_edge_mode)
    local allocation_count = measurement_count
    if allocation_count < 16 then
        allocation_count = 16
    end
    if oe_m5_buffer ~= nil and oe_m5_buffer.capacity ~= allocation_count then
        buffer.delete(oe_m5_buffer)
        oe_m5_buffer = nil
        oe_m5_buffer_capacity = 0
        collectgarbage()
    end
    if oe_m5_buffer == nil then
        oe_m5_buffer = buffer.make(allocation_count, buffer.STYLE_STANDARD)
    end
    oe_m5_buffer_capacity = oe_m5_buffer.capacity
    if oe_m5_buffer_capacity < measurement_count then
        error("M5 proof buffer capacity is smaller than the requested count")
    end
    oe_m5_buffer.fillmode = buffer.FILL_ONCE
    smu.measure.func = smu.FUNC_DC_VOLTAGE
    smu.measure.autorange = smu.OFF
    smu.measure.range = 0.2
    smu.measure.nplc = measurement_nplc
    smu.measure.filter.enable = smu.OFF
    smu.measure.rel.enable = smu.OFF
    smu.measure.autozero.enable = smu.OFF
    smu.measure.autozero.once()
    trigger.model.load("Empty")
    if external_start == 1 then
        trigger.model.setblock(1, trigger.BLOCK_DIGITAL_IO, oe_m4_pattern(true, false), oe_m4_mask())
        trigger.model.setblock(2, trigger.BLOCK_NOTIFY, trigger.EVENT_NOTIFY1)
        trigger.model.setblock(3, trigger.BLOCK_BRANCH_ON_EVENT, trigger.EVENT_TIMER1, 15)
        trigger.model.setblock(4, trigger.BLOCK_BRANCH_ON_EVENT, oe_m4_digio_event(start_line), 7)
        trigger.model.setblock(5, trigger.BLOCK_DELAY_CONSTANT, event_poll_s)
        trigger.model.setblock(6, trigger.BLOCK_BRANCH_ALWAYS, 3)
        trigger.model.setblock(7, trigger.BLOCK_DIGITAL_IO, oe_m4_pattern(false, true), oe_m4_mask())
        trigger.model.setblock(8, trigger.BLOCK_BUFFER_CLEAR, oe_m5_buffer)
        trigger.model.setblock(9, trigger.BLOCK_SOURCE_OUTPUT, smu.ON)
        trigger.model.setblock(10, trigger.BLOCK_MEASURE_DIGITIZE, oe_m5_buffer, measurement_count)
        trigger.model.setblock(11, trigger.BLOCK_SOURCE_OUTPUT, smu.OFF)
        trigger.model.setblock(12, trigger.BLOCK_DIGITAL_IO, oe_m4_pattern(false, false), oe_m4_mask())
        trigger.model.setblock(13, trigger.BLOCK_NOTIFY, trigger.EVENT_NOTIFY2)
        trigger.model.setblock(14, trigger.BLOCK_BRANCH_ALWAYS, 0)
        trigger.model.setblock(15, trigger.BLOCK_SOURCE_OUTPUT, smu.OFF)
        trigger.model.setblock(16, trigger.BLOCK_DIGITAL_IO, oe_m4_pattern(false, false), oe_m4_mask())
        trigger.model.setblock(17, trigger.BLOCK_NOTIFY, trigger.EVENT_NOTIFY3)
        oe_m4_mode = "external"
        oe_m4_complete_block = 13
        oe_m4_timeout_block = 17
    else
        trigger.model.setblock(1, trigger.BLOCK_DIGITAL_IO, oe_m4_pattern(false, true), oe_m4_mask())
        trigger.model.setblock(2, trigger.BLOCK_BUFFER_CLEAR, oe_m5_buffer)
        trigger.model.setblock(3, trigger.BLOCK_SOURCE_OUTPUT, smu.ON)
        trigger.model.setblock(4, trigger.BLOCK_MEASURE_DIGITIZE, oe_m5_buffer, measurement_count)
        trigger.model.setblock(5, trigger.BLOCK_SOURCE_OUTPUT, smu.OFF)
        trigger.model.setblock(6, trigger.BLOCK_DIGITAL_IO, oe_m4_pattern(false, false), oe_m4_mask())
        trigger.model.setblock(7, trigger.BLOCK_NOTIFY, trigger.EVENT_NOTIFY2)
        oe_m4_mode = "immediate_acquisition"
        oe_m4_complete_block = 7
        oe_m4_timeout_block = 0
    end
    oe_m5_measurement_count = measurement_count
    oe_m5_measurement_profile_code = measurement_profile
    oe_m4_state = "prepared"
end
function oe_m5_prepare_current_hold_acquisition(
    current_a,
    source_range_a,
    voltage_limit_v,
    measurement_count,
    external_start,
    start_timeout_s,
    event_poll_s,
    front_terminals,
    remote_sense,
    ready_line,
    busy_line,
    start_line,
    ready_asserted,
    busy_asserted,
    start_edge_mode)
    oe_m5_prepare_profiled_current_hold_acquisition(
        current_a,
        source_range_a,
        voltage_limit_v,
        measurement_count,
        external_start,
        start_timeout_s,
        event_poll_s,
        front_terminals,
        remote_sense,
        ready_line,
        busy_line,
        start_line,
        ready_asserted,
        busy_asserted,
        start_edge_mode,
        1)
end
function oe_m5_measurement_profile_status()
    return oe_m5_measurement_profile_code,
        smu.measure.nplc,
        smu.measure.range,
        smu.measure.autorange,
        smu.measure.filter.enable,
        smu.measure.rel.enable,
        smu.measure.autozero.enable
end
function oe_m5_prepare_timestamp_proof(
    proof_run_id,
    current_a,
    source_range_a,
    voltage_limit_v,
    start_timeout_s,
    event_poll_s,
    front_terminals,
    remote_sense,
    ready_line,
    busy_line,
    start_line,
    ready_asserted,
    busy_asserted,
    start_edge_mode)
    oe_m4_require_number(proof_run_id, "proof_run_id")
    if proof_run_id < 1 or proof_run_id ~= math.floor(proof_run_id) then
        error("M5 timestamp proof run ID must be a positive integer")
    end
    local proof_suffix = ":" .. tostring(proof_run_id)
    oe_m5_prepare_current_hold_acquisition(
        current_a,
        source_range_a,
        voltage_limit_v,
        1,
        1,
        start_timeout_s,
        event_poll_s,
        front_terminals,
        remote_sense,
        ready_line,
        busy_line,
        start_line,
        ready_asserted,
        busy_asserted,
        start_edge_mode)
    trigger.model.load("Empty")
    trigger.model.setblock(1, trigger.BLOCK_DIGITAL_IO, oe_m4_pattern(true, false), oe_m4_mask())
    trigger.model.setblock(2, trigger.BLOCK_NOTIFY, trigger.EVENT_NOTIFY1)
    trigger.model.setblock(3, trigger.BLOCK_BRANCH_ON_EVENT, trigger.EVENT_TIMER1, 19)
    trigger.model.setblock(4, trigger.BLOCK_BRANCH_ON_EVENT, oe_m4_digio_event(start_line), 7)
    trigger.model.setblock(5, trigger.BLOCK_DELAY_CONSTANT, event_poll_s)
    trigger.model.setblock(6, trigger.BLOCK_BRANCH_ALWAYS, 3)
    trigger.model.setblock(7, trigger.BLOCK_LOG_EVENT, trigger.LOG_INFO1, "OE_TS_PRE_BUSY" .. proof_suffix)
    trigger.model.setblock(8, trigger.BLOCK_DIGITAL_IO, oe_m4_pattern(false, true), oe_m4_mask())
    trigger.model.setblock(9, trigger.BLOCK_LOG_EVENT, trigger.LOG_INFO2, "OE_TS_POST_BUSY" .. proof_suffix)
    trigger.model.setblock(10, trigger.BLOCK_BUFFER_CLEAR, oe_m5_buffer)
    trigger.model.setblock(11, trigger.BLOCK_SOURCE_OUTPUT, smu.ON)
    trigger.model.setblock(12, trigger.BLOCK_LOG_EVENT, trigger.LOG_INFO3, "OE_TS_PRE_MEASURE" .. proof_suffix)
    trigger.model.setblock(13, trigger.BLOCK_MEASURE_DIGITIZE, oe_m5_buffer, 1)
    trigger.model.setblock(14, trigger.BLOCK_LOG_EVENT, trigger.LOG_INFO4, "OE_TS_POST_MEASURE" .. proof_suffix)
    trigger.model.setblock(15, trigger.BLOCK_SOURCE_OUTPUT, smu.OFF)
    trigger.model.setblock(16, trigger.BLOCK_DIGITAL_IO, oe_m4_pattern(false, false), oe_m4_mask())
    trigger.model.setblock(17, trigger.BLOCK_NOTIFY, trigger.EVENT_NOTIFY2)
    trigger.model.setblock(18, trigger.BLOCK_BRANCH_ALWAYS, 0)
    trigger.model.setblock(19, trigger.BLOCK_SOURCE_OUTPUT, smu.OFF)
    trigger.model.setblock(20, trigger.BLOCK_DIGITAL_IO, oe_m4_pattern(false, false), oe_m4_mask())
    trigger.model.setblock(21, trigger.BLOCK_NOTIFY, trigger.EVENT_NOTIFY3)
    oe_m4_mode = "external"
    oe_m4_complete_block = 17
    oe_m4_timeout_block = 21
    oe_m5_measurement_count = 1
    oe_m4_state = "prepared"
end
function oe_m5_timestamp_proof_reading()
    if oe_m4_model_active() or smu.source.output ~= smu.OFF then
        error("M5 timestamp proof retrieval requires an inactive model and output off")
    end
    if oe_m5_buffer == nil or oe_m5_buffer.n ~= 1 then
        error("M5 timestamp proof requires exactly one retained reading")
    end
    local index = oe_m5_buffer.startindex
    return oe_m5_buffer.seconds[index],
        oe_m5_buffer.fractionalseconds[index],
        oe_m5_buffer.relativetimestamps[index],
        smu.measure.nplc,
        localnode.linefreq
end
function oe_m5_buffer_status()
    if oe_m5_buffer == nil or oe_m5_buffer.n == 0 then
        return 0, 0, 0, oe_m5_buffer_capacity
    end
    return oe_m5_buffer.n,
        oe_m5_buffer.startindex,
        oe_m5_buffer.endindex,
        oe_m5_buffer.capacity
end
function oe_m5_print_buffer(first_index, last_index)
    oe_m4_require_number(first_index, "first_index")
    oe_m4_require_number(last_index, "last_index")
    if first_index ~= math.floor(first_index) or last_index ~= math.floor(last_index) then
        error("M5 proof buffer indices must be integers")
    end
    if oe_m4_model_active() or smu.source.output ~= smu.OFF then
        error("M5 proof buffer retrieval requires an inactive model and output off")
    end
    if oe_m5_buffer == nil or first_index < oe_m5_buffer.startindex or
        last_index > oe_m5_buffer.endindex or first_index > last_index then
        error("M5 proof buffer retrieval indices are out of range")
    end
    if last_index - first_index + 1 > 4096 then
        error("M5 proof buffer retrieval is limited to 4096 records per transfer")
    end
    printbuffer(
        first_index,
        last_index,
        oe_m5_buffer.sourcevalues,
        oe_m5_buffer.readings,
        oe_m5_buffer.relativetimestamps,
        oe_m5_buffer.sourcestatuses,
        oe_m5_buffer.statuses)
end
function oe_m5_discard_buffer()
    if oe_m4_model_active() or smu.source.output ~= smu.OFF then
        error("M5 proof discard requires an inactive model and output off")
    end
    if oe_m5_buffer ~= nil then
        oe_m5_buffer.clear()
    end
    oe_m5_measurement_count = 0
end
function oe_m4_prepare_current_hold(
    current_a,
    source_range_a,
    voltage_limit_v,
    duration_s,
    external_start,
    start_timeout_s,
    event_poll_s,
    front_terminals,
    remote_sense,
    ready_line,
    busy_line,
    start_line,
    ready_asserted,
    busy_asserted,
    start_edge_mode)
    oe_m4_require_number(current_a, "current_a")
    oe_m4_require_number(source_range_a, "source_range_a")
    oe_m4_require_number(voltage_limit_v, "voltage_limit_v")
    oe_m4_require_number(duration_s, "duration_s")
    oe_m4_require_number(start_timeout_s, "start_timeout_s")
    oe_m4_require_number(event_poll_s, "event_poll_s")
    oe_m4_require_line(ready_line, "ready_line")
    oe_m4_require_line(busy_line, "busy_line")
    oe_m4_require_line(start_line, "start_line")
    if math.abs(current_a) > 0.01 then
        error("M4 proof current is limited to 10 mA")
    end
    if source_range_a <= 0 or source_range_a > 0.01 or math.abs(current_a) > source_range_a then
        error("M4 proof source range is invalid")
    end
    if voltage_limit_v < 0.01 or voltage_limit_v > 2 then
        error("M4 proof voltage limit must be in 0.01..2 V")
    end
    if duration_s < 0.001 or duration_s > 60 then
        error("M4 proof duration must be in 0.001..60 s")
    end
    if start_timeout_s < 0.001 or start_timeout_s > 60 then
        error("M4 proof start timeout must be in 0.001..60 s")
    end
    if event_poll_s < 0.001 or event_poll_s > 0.1 then
        error("M4 proof event poll must be in 0.001..0.1 s")
    end
    if ready_line == busy_line or ready_line == start_line or busy_line == start_line then
        error("M4 proof digital lines must be unique")
    end
    if (ready_asserted ~= 0 and ready_asserted ~= 1) or
        (busy_asserted ~= 0 and busy_asserted ~= 1) then
        error("M4 proof flag levels must be 0 or 1")
    end
    if start_edge_mode ~= 0 and start_edge_mode ~= 1 and start_edge_mode ~= 2 then
        error("M4 proof START edge mode must be falling, rising, or either")
    end
    if oe_m4_model_active() then
        error("cannot prepare while trigger model is active")
    end
    if smu.source.output ~= smu.OFF then
        error("cannot prepare while source output is on")
    end
    trigger.model.abort()
    trigger.timer[1].enable = trigger.OFF
    smu.source.output = smu.OFF
    smu.source.level = 0
    oe_m4_ready_line = ready_line
    oe_m4_busy_line = busy_line
    oe_m4_start_line = start_line
    oe_m4_start_level = -1
    oe_m4_ready_asserted = ready_asserted
    oe_m4_busy_asserted = busy_asserted
    digio.line[ready_line].mode = digio.MODE_DIGITAL_OUT
    digio.line[busy_line].mode = digio.MODE_DIGITAL_OUT
    oe_m4_set_flags(false, false)
    if external_start == 1 then
        digio.line[start_line].mode = digio.MODE_TRIGGER_IN
        if start_edge_mode == 1 then
            trigger.digin[start_line].edge = trigger.EDGE_RISING
        elseif start_edge_mode == 2 then
            trigger.digin[start_line].edge = trigger.EDGE_EITHER
        else
            trigger.digin[start_line].edge = trigger.EDGE_FALLING
        end
        trigger.digin[start_line].clear()
    end
    if front_terminals == 1 then
        smu.terminals = smu.TERMINALS_FRONT
    else
        smu.terminals = smu.TERMINALS_REAR
    end
    smu.source.func = smu.FUNC_DC_CURRENT
    smu.source.level = 0
    smu.source.autorange = smu.OFF
    smu.source.range = source_range_a
    smu.source.vlimit.level = voltage_limit_v
    smu.source.readback = smu.ON
    smu.source.offmode = smu.OFFMODE_NORMAL
    smu.measure.func = smu.FUNC_DC_VOLTAGE
    if remote_sense == 1 then
        smu.measure.sense = smu.SENSE_4WIRE
    else
        smu.measure.sense = smu.SENSE_2WIRE
    end
    smu.source.level = current_a
    trigger.model.load("Empty")
    if external_start == 1 then
        trigger.timer[1].reset()
        trigger.timer[1].delay = start_timeout_s
        trigger.timer[1].start.stimulus = trigger.EVENT_NOTIFY1
        trigger.timer[1].start.generate = trigger.OFF
        trigger.timer[1].count = 1
        trigger.timer[1].enable = trigger.ON
        trigger.model.setblock(1, trigger.BLOCK_DIGITAL_IO, oe_m4_pattern(true, false), oe_m4_mask())
        trigger.model.setblock(2, trigger.BLOCK_NOTIFY, trigger.EVENT_NOTIFY1)
        trigger.model.setblock(3, trigger.BLOCK_BRANCH_ON_EVENT, trigger.EVENT_TIMER1, 14)
        trigger.model.setblock(4, trigger.BLOCK_BRANCH_ON_EVENT, oe_m4_digio_event(start_line), 7)
        trigger.model.setblock(5, trigger.BLOCK_DELAY_CONSTANT, event_poll_s)
        trigger.model.setblock(6, trigger.BLOCK_BRANCH_ALWAYS, 3)
        trigger.model.setblock(7, trigger.BLOCK_DIGITAL_IO, oe_m4_pattern(false, true), oe_m4_mask())
        trigger.model.setblock(8, trigger.BLOCK_SOURCE_OUTPUT, smu.ON)
        trigger.model.setblock(9, trigger.BLOCK_DELAY_CONSTANT, duration_s)
        trigger.model.setblock(10, trigger.BLOCK_SOURCE_OUTPUT, smu.OFF)
        trigger.model.setblock(11, trigger.BLOCK_DIGITAL_IO, oe_m4_pattern(false, false), oe_m4_mask())
        trigger.model.setblock(12, trigger.BLOCK_NOTIFY, trigger.EVENT_NOTIFY2)
        trigger.model.setblock(13, trigger.BLOCK_BRANCH_ALWAYS, 0)
        trigger.model.setblock(14, trigger.BLOCK_SOURCE_OUTPUT, smu.OFF)
        trigger.model.setblock(15, trigger.BLOCK_DIGITAL_IO, oe_m4_pattern(false, false), oe_m4_mask())
        trigger.model.setblock(16, trigger.BLOCK_NOTIFY, trigger.EVENT_NOTIFY3)
        oe_m4_mode = "external"
        oe_m4_complete_block = 12
        oe_m4_timeout_block = 16
    else
        trigger.model.setblock(1, trigger.BLOCK_DIGITAL_IO, oe_m4_pattern(false, true), oe_m4_mask())
        trigger.model.setblock(2, trigger.BLOCK_SOURCE_OUTPUT, smu.ON)
        trigger.model.setblock(3, trigger.BLOCK_DELAY_CONSTANT, duration_s)
        trigger.model.setblock(4, trigger.BLOCK_SOURCE_OUTPUT, smu.OFF)
        trigger.model.setblock(5, trigger.BLOCK_DIGITAL_IO, oe_m4_pattern(false, false), oe_m4_mask())
        trigger.model.setblock(6, trigger.BLOCK_NOTIFY, trigger.EVENT_NOTIFY2)
        oe_m4_mode = "immediate"
        oe_m4_complete_block = 6
        oe_m4_timeout_block = 0
    end
    oe_m4_state = "prepared"
end
function oe_m4_arm()
    if oe_m4_state ~= "prepared" then
        error("M4 proof runtime is not prepared")
    end
    if smu.source.output ~= smu.OFF then
        error("M4 proof output is not off before arm")
    end
    if oe_m4_mode == "external" then
        local configured_edge = trigger.digin[oe_m4_start_line].edge
        if configured_edge == trigger.EDGE_EITHER then
            oe_m4_start_level = -1
        else
            local expected_inactive = digio.STATE_LOW
            if configured_edge == trigger.EDGE_FALLING then
                expected_inactive = digio.STATE_HIGH
            end

            oe_m4_start_level = digio.line[oe_m4_start_line].state
            if oe_m4_start_level ~= expected_inactive then
                error("START input is asserted before arm")
            end
            digio.line[oe_m4_start_line].mode = digio.MODE_TRIGGER_IN
            trigger.digin[oe_m4_start_line].edge = configured_edge
        end
        trigger.digin[oe_m4_start_line].clear()
        trigger.timer[1].clear()

        oe_m4_state = "running"

function oe_m4_refresh_state()
    local model_state, model_substate, block = trigger.model.state()
    if oe_m4_state == "running" or oe_m4_state == "waiting_start" then
        if oe_m4_state == "waiting_start" and model_state ~= trigger.STATE_IDLE and
            block >= 7 and block <= oe_m4_complete_block then
            oe_m4_state = "running"
        end
        if model_state == trigger.STATE_IDLE then
            if block == oe_m4_complete_block then
                oe_m4_state = "complete"
            elseif block == oe_m4_timeout_block then
                oe_m4_state = "start_timeout"
            else
                oe_m4_state = "error"
            end
        elseif model_state == trigger.STATE_ABORTED then
            oe_m4_state = "aborted"
        elseif model_state == trigger.STATE_FAILED then
            oe_m4_state = "error"
        end
    end
    if oe_m4_state == "waiting_start" then
        oe_m4_track_flags(true, false)
    elseif oe_m4_state == "running" then
        oe_m4_track_flags(false, true)
    else
        oe_m4_track_flags(false, false)
    end
    return model_state, model_substate, block
end
function oe_m4_status()
    local model_state, model_substate, block = oe_m4_refresh_state()
    local start_overrun = false
    if oe_m4_mode == "external" then
        start_overrun = trigger.digin[oe_m4_start_line].overrun
    end
    return oe_m4_runtime_abi,
        oe_m4_state,
        model_state,
        model_substate,
        block,
        smu.source.output,
        oe_m4_ready_level,
        oe_m4_busy_level,
        oe_m4_start_level,
        start_overrun,
        trigger.timer[1].start.overrun
end
function oe_m4_abort()
    trigger.model.abort()
    trigger.timer[1].enable = trigger.OFF
    smu.source.output = smu.OFF
    oe_m4_set_flags(false, false)
    smu.source.level = 0
    oe_m4_start_level = -1
    oe_m4_state = "aborted"
end
function oe_m4_force_safe()
    trigger.model.abort()
    trigger.timer[1].enable = trigger.OFF
    smu.source.output = smu.OFF
    oe_m4_set_flags(false, false)
    smu.source.level = 0
    oe_m4_start_level = -1
    oe_m4_state = "aborted"
end
function oe_m4_recover()
    local model_state = trigger.model.state()
    if model_state == trigger.STATE_RUNNING or model_state == trigger.STATE_WAITING or
        model_state == trigger.STATE_ABORTING then
        error("cannot recover while trigger model is active")
    end
    if smu.source.output ~= smu.OFF then
        error("cannot recover with output on")
    end
    trigger.timer[1].enable = trigger.OFF
    oe_m4_set_flags(false, false)
    smu.source.level = 0
    oe_m4_start_level = -1
    oe_m4_state = "idle"
end
-- Candidate timed resistor hold extension; concatenate after exact packaged v14.
-- NO TIMING/LATENCY ACCEPTANCE: sequential measurement cannot be preempted here.
-- Reference: Keithley 2460 Reference Manual Rev. C, TSP sections 14-248,
-- 14-251, 14-267..269, 14-271..278. In particular WAIT/CLEAR_NEVER acts on
-- retained events, and exit clears its recorded event. BRANCH_ON_EVENT does
-- not document event clearing; this model never uses it to consume cadence.
-- Timer4 deadlines are finite {P/2,P,...,P}, not alternating half/full delays.
-- Deadline-event consumption, local cutoff, abort responsiveness, clock origin,
-- physical duration and sample timing require resistor commissioning evidence.
oe_m4_runtime_build = "m4-finite-current-hold-v17"
oe_timed_enabled = false
oe_timed_cause = "not_started"
oe_timed_count = 0
oe_timed_lower_cutoff = 0
oe_timed_upper_cutoff = 0
oe_timed_complete_block = 0
oe_timed_timeout_block = 0
oe_timed_cutoff_block = 0
oe_timed_deadline_block = 0
oe_timed_overrun_block = 0
local oe_timed_base_initialize = oe_m4_initialize
local oe_timed_base_refresh = oe_m4_refresh_state
local oe_timed_base_abort = oe_m4_abort
local oe_timed_base_force_safe = oe_m4_force_safe
local oe_timed_base_recover = oe_m4_recover
local oe_timed_base_prepare = oe_m4_prepare_current_hold
local function oe_timed_disable_timers()
    trigger.timer[2].enable = trigger.OFF
    trigger.timer[3].enable = trigger.OFF
    trigger.timer[4].enable = trigger.OFF
end
function oe_m4_initialize()
    oe_timed_disable_timers()
    oe_timed_base_initialize()
    trigger.model.load("Empty")
    oe_timed_enabled = false
    oe_timed_cause = "not_started"
end
function oe_m4_prepare_current_hold(
    current_a, source_range_a, voltage_limit_v, duration_s, external_start,
    start_timeout_s, event_poll_s, front_terminals, remote_sense,
    ready_line, busy_line, start_line, ready_asserted, busy_asserted,
    start_edge_mode)
    -- Keep the original proof entry points usable without interpreting their
    -- block numbers as timed-hold outcomes. The base guard runs before changes.
    oe_timed_base_prepare(
        current_a, source_range_a, voltage_limit_v, duration_s, external_start,
        start_timeout_s, event_poll_s, front_terminals, remote_sense,
        ready_line, busy_line, start_line, ready_asserted, busy_asserted,
        start_edge_mode)
    oe_timed_disable_timers()
    oe_timed_enabled = false
    oe_timed_cause = "not_started"
end
function oe_timed_prepare_current_hold(
    current_a, source_range_a, voltage_limit_v, duration_s, sample_period_s,
    measurement_count, lower_cutoff_v, upper_cutoff_v, external_start,
    start_timeout_s, event_poll_s, front_terminals, remote_sense,
    ready_line, busy_line, start_line, ready_asserted, busy_asserted,
    start_edge_mode, measurement_profile)
    oe_m4_require_number(duration_s, "duration_s")
    oe_m4_require_number(sample_period_s, "sample_period_s")
    oe_m4_require_number(measurement_count, "measurement_count")
    oe_m4_require_number(lower_cutoff_v, "lower_cutoff_v")
    oe_m4_require_number(upper_cutoff_v, "upper_cutoff_v")
    if sample_period_s < 0.1 or duration_s < sample_period_s or duration_s > 60 then
        error("timed hold requires 0.1 <= period <= duration <= 60 s")
    end
    if measurement_count < 1 or measurement_count > 600 or
        measurement_count ~= math.floor(measurement_count) or
        math.abs(duration_s - sample_period_s * measurement_count) > 1e-12 then

    local setup_voltage_limit = voltage_limit_v
    local setup_profile = measurement_profile

        setup_voltage_limit = math.min(voltage_limit_v, 0.2)
        setup_profile = 1
    end
    if voltage_limit_v < 0.106 * measurement_range or voltage_limit_v > measurement_range then
        error("timed hold compliance exceeds the selected measurement range")
    end
    if lower_cutoff_v < -measurement_range or upper_cutoff_v > measurement_range or
        lower_cutoff_v < -voltage_limit_v or upper_cutoff_v > voltage_limit_v or
        lower_cutoff_v >= upper_cutoff_v then
        error("timed hold cutoff bounds are invalid")

    -- allocates fill-once storage, and applies the immutable measurement profile.
    -- Rev. C 4-73/14-194: set measure range BEFORE its compatible source limit.
    -- First transition safely to the unchanged v14 initializer's 0.2 V range.

        error("timed setup requires stopped model and output OFF")

    if oe_m5_buffer ~= nil and oe_m5_buffer.n > 0 then
        error("retained data must be explicitly dispositioned before timed setup")

    smu.source.level = 0
    smu.measure.func = smu.FUNC_DC_VOLTAGE

        current_a, source_range_a, setup_voltage_limit, measurement_count,
        external_start, start_timeout_s, event_poll_s, front_terminals,
        remote_sense, ready_line, busy_line, start_line, ready_asserted,
        busy_asserted, start_edge_mode, setup_profile)

        -- The unchanged v14 proof initializer never receives profile code 4.

        smu.source.vlimit.level = voltage_limit_v

        oe_m5_measurement_profile_code = 4

    trigger.timer[2].delay = duration_s
    trigger.timer[2].start.stimulus = trigger.EVENT_NOTIFY4
    trigger.timer[2].start.generate = trigger.OFF
    trigger.timer[2].count = 1
    trigger.timer[2].enable = trigger.ON
    trigger.timer[3].reset()
    trigger.timer[3].delay = sample_period_s
    trigger.timer[3].start.stimulus = trigger.EVENT_NOTIFY4
    trigger.timer[3].start.generate = trigger.OFF
    trigger.timer[3].count = measurement_count

    for index = 2, measurement_count do

    trigger.timer[4].reset()
    trigger.timer[4].delaylist = deadlines
    trigger.timer[4].start.stimulus = trigger.EVENT_NOTIFY4

    trigger.timer[4].count = measurement_count
    trigger.timer[4].enable = trigger.ON

        trigger.model.setblock(block(4), trigger.BLOCK_BRANCH_ON_EVENT, oe_m4_digio_event(start_line), block(7))
        trigger.model.setblock(block(5), trigger.BLOCK_DELAY_CONSTANT, event_poll_s)
        trigger.model.setblock(block(6), trigger.BLOCK_BRANCH_ALWAYS, block(3))

    trigger.model.setblock(block(7), trigger.BLOCK_DIGITAL_IO, oe_m4_pattern(false, true), oe_m4_mask())
    trigger.model.setblock(block(8), trigger.BLOCK_BUFFER_CLEAR, oe_m5_buffer)
    trigger.model.setblock(block(9), trigger.BLOCK_SOURCE_OUTPUT, smu.ON)
    trigger.model.setblock(block(10), trigger.BLOCK_NOTIFY, trigger.EVENT_NOTIFY4)
    -- Pending half-slot deadline before measurement means no catch-up sample.
    trigger.model.setblock(block(11), trigger.BLOCK_BRANCH_ON_EVENT, trigger.EVENT_TIMER4, block(36))
    trigger.model.setblock(block(12), trigger.BLOCK_MEASURE_DIGITIZE, oe_m5_buffer, 1)
    trigger.model.setblock(block(13), trigger.BLOCK_BRANCH_LIMIT_CONSTANT,
        trigger.LIMIT_OUTSIDE, lower_cutoff_v, upper_cutoff_v, block(24), block(12))
    trigger.model.setblock(block(14), trigger.BLOCK_BRANCH_ON_EVENT, trigger.EVENT_TIMER4, block(28))

    trigger.model.setblock(block(16), trigger.BLOCK_BRANCH_COUNTER, measurement_count, block(22))
    trigger.model.setblock(block(17), trigger.BLOCK_WAIT, trigger.EVENT_TIMER2, trigger.CLEAR_NEVER)
    trigger.model.setblock(block(18), trigger.BLOCK_SOURCE_OUTPUT, smu.OFF)
    trigger.model.setblock(block(19), trigger.BLOCK_DIGITAL_IO, oe_m4_pattern(false, false), oe_m4_mask())
    trigger.model.setblock(block(20), trigger.BLOCK_NOTIFY, trigger.EVENT_NOTIFY2)
    trigger.model.setblock(block(21), trigger.BLOCK_BRANCH_ALWAYS, block(0))
    trigger.model.setblock(block(22), trigger.BLOCK_WAIT, trigger.EVENT_TIMER3, trigger.CLEAR_NEVER)
    trigger.model.setblock(block(23), trigger.BLOCK_BRANCH_ALWAYS, block(11))
    trigger.model.setblock(block(24), trigger.BLOCK_SOURCE_OUTPUT, smu.OFF)
    trigger.model.setblock(block(25), trigger.BLOCK_DIGITAL_IO, oe_m4_pattern(false, false), oe_m4_mask())
    trigger.model.setblock(block(26), trigger.BLOCK_NOTIFY, trigger.EVENT_NOTIFY5)
    trigger.model.setblock(block(27), trigger.BLOCK_BRANCH_ALWAYS, block(0))
    trigger.model.setblock(block(28), trigger.BLOCK_SOURCE_OUTPUT, smu.OFF)
    trigger.model.setblock(block(29), trigger.BLOCK_DIGITAL_IO, oe_m4_pattern(false, false), oe_m4_mask())
    trigger.model.setblock(block(30), trigger.BLOCK_NOTIFY, trigger.EVENT_NOTIFY6)
    trigger.model.setblock(block(31), trigger.BLOCK_BRANCH_ALWAYS, block(0))
    if external_start == 1 then

        trigger.model.setblock(block(33), trigger.BLOCK_DIGITAL_IO, oe_m4_pattern(false, false), oe_m4_mask())
        trigger.model.setblock(block(34), trigger.BLOCK_NOTIFY, trigger.EVENT_NOTIFY3)
        trigger.model.setblock(block(35), trigger.BLOCK_BRANCH_ALWAYS, block(0))
    end
    trigger.model.setblock(block(36), trigger.BLOCK_SOURCE_OUTPUT, smu.OFF)
    trigger.model.setblock(block(37), trigger.BLOCK_DIGITAL_IO, oe_m4_pattern(false, false), oe_m4_mask())
    trigger.model.setblock(block(38), trigger.BLOCK_NOTIFY, trigger.EVENT_NOTIFY7)
    trigger.model.setblock(block(39), trigger.BLOCK_BRANCH_ALWAYS, block(0))
    oe_timed_complete_block = block(20)
    oe_timed_timeout_block = 0
    if external_start == 1 then oe_timed_timeout_block = block(34) end
    oe_timed_cutoff_block = block(26)
    oe_timed_deadline_block = block(30)
    oe_timed_overrun_block = block(38)
    oe_timed_enabled = true
    oe_timed_cause = "prepared"
    oe_timed_count = measurement_count
    oe_timed_lower_cutoff = lower_cutoff_v
    oe_timed_upper_cutoff = upper_cutoff_v
    oe_m4_complete_block = oe_timed_complete_block
    oe_m4_timeout_block = oe_timed_timeout_block

    else

end
function oe_timed_plan_status()
    local deadlines = trigger.timer[4].delaylist
    return trigger.timer[2].delay, trigger.timer[3].delay, oe_timed_count,
        oe_timed_lower_cutoff, oe_timed_upper_cutoff, deadlines[1]
end
function oe_m4_refresh_state()
    local was_active = oe_m4_state == "running" or oe_m4_state == "waiting_start"
    local model_state, model_substate, block = oe_timed_base_refresh()
    if oe_timed_enabled and was_active then
        if model_state == trigger.STATE_IDLE then
            if block == oe_timed_complete_block then
                oe_timed_cause = "normal_completion"
            elseif oe_timed_timeout_block > 0 and block == oe_timed_timeout_block then
                oe_timed_cause = "start_timeout"
            elseif block == oe_timed_cutoff_block then
                oe_timed_cause = "voltage_cutoff"
                oe_m4_state = "error"
            elseif block == oe_timed_deadline_block then
                oe_timed_cause = "measurement_deadline"
                oe_m4_state = "error"
            elseif block == oe_timed_overrun_block then
                oe_timed_cause = "cadence_overrun"
                oe_m4_state = "error"
            else
                oe_timed_cause = "runtime_error"
            end
        elseif model_state == trigger.STATE_FAILED then
            oe_timed_cause = "runtime_error"
        elseif model_state == trigger.STATE_ABORTED then
            oe_timed_cause = "operator_abort"
        elseif oe_m4_mode ~= "external" or block >= 7 then
            oe_m4_state = "running"
            oe_timed_cause = "running"
            oe_m4_track_flags(false, true)
        end

    -- explicit abort/force-safe/recovery and preparation disable them as needed.
    return model_state, model_substate, block

function oe_timed_terminal_cause()
    oe_m4_refresh_state()
    return oe_timed_cause
end
function oe_m4_abort()
    oe_timed_disable_timers()
    oe_timed_base_abort()
    if oe_timed_enabled then oe_timed_cause = "operator_abort" end
end
function oe_m4_force_safe()
    oe_timed_disable_timers()
    oe_timed_base_force_safe()
    if oe_timed_enabled then oe_timed_cause = "operator_abort" end
end
function oe_m4_recover()
    -- Base recovery checks stopped/OFF before the extension changes timers.
    oe_timed_base_recover()
    oe_timed_disable_timers()
    trigger.model.load("Empty")
end
